_note: The synthetic tenant's notes on two handbook clauses that the OSH Code speaks to (acme/hr_policy_2026.md:19-25 against acme/osh_code_2020.md:1537-1562). The handbook desk shows a note beside an answer that cites its clause. Each note says what the Code's text says and leaves the question of who it covers to the People team: the Code's worker (s.2(1)(zzl), lines 663-676) leaves out, among others, a person employed mainly in a managerial or administrative capacity. Keys that start with _ are notes: make desk does not write them.

LV-01.note: The OSH Code, s.32(1)(vii) to (ix): a worker may carry forward up to 30 days of leave, and leave they applied for and were refused carries forward without any limit; a worker may ask for leave to be encashed at the end of the calendar year, and may encash leave above 30 days. The OSH Code gives workers these rights; whether they apply to your role is a question for the People team.

basis.instrument: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020

LV-07.note: The OSH Code, s.32(1)(vi): a worker who is discharged or dismissed, or who quits, is entitled to wages in lieu of the leave they were entitled to, even if they had not yet worked long enough to take it, paid before the expiry of the second working day from the date of the discharge, dismissal or quitting. The OSH Code gives workers these rights; whether they apply to your role is a question for the People team.

basis.instrument: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
